implementation_policy: libuipc CUDA IPC solve of a 4.54 kg medicine ball (affine rigid body) striking a two-layer compressible StableNeoHookean FEM foam core inside a loose Baraff-Witkin thin-shell PVC cover, with the native objective metric and dihedral viscosity extension (scripts/pcve_native_viscosity.cu, prebuilt in .runtime/gym_landing_mat/native_cuda12) solved in the same Newton/IPC system; the ADD edit is an independent dynamic affine-body bottle. Every case starts from the accepted source FEM state (assets native/<case>/initial_state.npz, rest arrays loaded byte-exactly) and changes only its DSL-resolved parameter; no motion or deformation is authored. Rendering replays the native shell vertices and rigid transforms into the accepted packed scene with the fixed camera: appearance/render_replay.py is the frozen accepted renderer and appearance/realism.py (the default look) runs it unchanged apart from one hook that restyles lights, materials and static dressing. tools/export_ground_truth.py writes each case's ground truth from its native cache and the reference camera. Solves and renders run directly on a claimed local GPU or on pool GPUs via tools/worker_run.py (scene_paths.py). The accepted native delivery is renders/gym_landing_mat/accepted (scene_manifest.json data.accepted_delivery; --stage verify checks its videos, native clocks and edit parameters); the published videos are the suite named in scene_manifest.json canonical_suites. Effective material parameters, not fitted to a measured mat.
